title: "`r paste0('PPI Network Analysis — ', params$experiment_name)`"
author: ""
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%Y-%m-%d')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
    toc: yes
    toc_depth: 3
    toc_float: yes
    code_folding: hide
    df_print: paged
params:
  experiment_name: "Positive Selection Candidates"
  # Named list of species configurations (set in render_ppi.R)
  species_configs: !r list()
  # STRING combined score threshold for retaining interactions
  score_threshold: 0.7
  # Number of permutations for the null distribution
  n_permutations: 200
  # niter = ecount(graph) * rewire_multiplier for the rewiring null
  rewire_multiplier: 10
  # Random seed for reproducibility
  seed: 123
  # Output directory for TSV result tables
  output_dir: "results/ppi"
---

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}

# ── Load candidate STRING IDs from a plain-text file (one ID per line) ────────
load_candidate_ids <- function(f) {
  ids <- readLines(f)
  unique(trimws(ids[nzchar(trimws(ids))]))
}

# ── Load & filter STRING interactions (Cytoscape edge-export CSV) ─────────────
# Handles the "shared name" format: "4565.XXXXX (pp) 4565.YYYYY"
load_interactions <- function(edge_file, score_threshold) {
  raw <- read_csv(edge_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if ("shared name" %in% names(raw)) {
    raw <- raw %>% mutate(
      node1 = str_extract(`shared name`, "^[^ ]+"),
      node2 = str_extract(`shared name`, "[^ ]+$")
    )
  } else {
    n1 <- intersect(c("node1", "protein1", "from"), names(raw))[1]
    n2 <- intersect(c("node2", "protein2", "to"),   names(raw))[1]
    if (is.na(n1) || is.na(n2))
      stop("Cannot detect node columns in edge file: ", edge_file)
    raw <- raw %>% rename(node1 = all_of(n1), node2 = all_of(n2))
  }

  score_col <- intersect(
    c("stringdb::score", "combined_score", "score"),
    names(raw)
  )[1]

  raw %>%
    transmute(
      node1 = as.character(node1),
      node2 = as.character(node2),
      score = if (!is.na(score_col)) as.numeric(.data[[score_col]]) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    filter(is.na(score) | score >= score_threshold)
}

# ── Load node descriptions (Cytoscape STRING node-export CSV) ─────────────────
# Returns: STRING_ID | short_id (display name) | description
load_node_info <- function(node_file) {
  empty <- tibble(STRING_ID = character(), short_id = character(), description = character())
  if (!file.exists(node_file)) return(empty)

  nd       <- read_csv(node_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  id_col   <- intersect(c("name", "stringdb::database identifier"), names(nd))[1]
  disp_col <- "display name"
  desc_col <- intersect(c("stringdb::description", "description"), names(nd))[1]

  if (is.na(id_col)) return(empty)

  tibble(
    STRING_ID   = as.character(nd[[id_col]]),
    short_id    = if (disp_col %in% names(nd)) as.character(nd[[disp_col]]) else NA_character_,
    description = if (!is.na(desc_col))          as.character(nd[[desc_col]]) else NA_character_
  ) %>% distinct()
}

# ── Gene length proxy from branch_specific_MKT_results.tsv ───────────────────
# Maps aestivum_ortholog (version-stripped) → STRING ID via the node file.
# Returns tibble: gene (STRING ID) | length
load_gene_lengths <- function(output_dir, node_file) {
  empty    <- tibble(gene = character(), length = numeric())
  mkt_file <- file.path(output_dir, "branch_specific_MKT_results.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(mkt_file) || !file.exists(node_file)) return(empty)

  mkt <- read_tsv(mkt_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Prefer explicit site-count columns; fall back to total polymorphism count
  len_col <- intersect(c("number_sites_S", "number_sites", "L_s"), names(mkt))[1]
  if (!is.na(len_col)) {
    mkt <- mkt %>% mutate(.len = as.numeric(.data[[len_col]]))
  } else if (all(c("num_pol_NS", "num_pol_S") %in% names(mkt))) {
    mkt <- mkt %>% mutate(.len = num_pol_NS + num_pol_S)
  } else {
    return(empty)
  }

  mkt_clean <- mkt %>%
    filter(!is.na(aestivum_ortholog), !is.na(.len)) %>%
    transmute(
      wheat_id = str_remove(aestivum_ortholog, "\\.[0-9]+$"),
      length   = .len
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  nd <- read_csv(node_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (!all(c("display name", "name") %in% names(nd))) return(empty)

  nd %>%
    transmute(wheat_id = `display name`, STRING_ID = name) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    inner_join(mkt_clean, by = "wheat_id") %>%
    transmute(gene = STRING_ID, length = as.numeric(length)) %>%
    distinct()
}

# ── Observed candidate subgraph metrics ───────────────────────────────────────
compute_metrics <- function(edges, pos_set) {
  k             <- length(pos_set)
  edges_between <- sum(edges$node1 %in% pos_set & edges$node2 %in% pos_set)
  possible      <- if (k >= 2) choose(k, 2) else NA_real_
  density       <- if (!is.na(possible) && possible > 0) edges_between / possible else NA_real_
  list(edges_between = edges_between, possible_pairs = possible, density = density)
}

# ── Sampling helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.sample_degree_matched <- function(all_genes, degree_tbl, pos_set, n_bins = 10) {
  tbl      <- degree_tbl %>% mutate(bin = ntile(degree, n_bins))
  pos_bins <- tbl %>% filter(gene %in% pos_set) %>% pull(bin)
  map_chr(pos_bins, function(b) {
    pool <- tbl %>% filter(bin == b, !(gene %in% pos_set)) %>% pull(gene)
    if (!length(pool)) pool <- setdiff(all_genes, pos_set)
    sample(pool, 1)
  }) %>% unique()
}

.sample_degree_length_matched <- function(all_genes, degree_tbl, length_tbl, pos_set,
                                           n_deg = 10, n_len = 5) {
  if (is.null(length_tbl) || nrow(length_tbl) == 0)
    return(.sample_degree_matched(all_genes, degree_tbl, pos_set, n_deg))

  combined <- degree_tbl %>%
    left_join(length_tbl, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      length  = if (all(is.na(length))) degree
                else replace_na(length, median(length, na.rm = TRUE)),
      deg_bin = ntile(degree, n_deg),
      len_bin = ntile(length, n_len),
      bin     = paste0(deg_bin, "_", len_bin)
    )

  pos_bins <- combined %>% filter(gene %in% pos_set) %>% pull(bin)
  map_chr(pos_bins, function(b) {
    pool <- combined %>% filter(bin == b, !(gene %in% pos_set)) %>% pull(gene)
    if (!length(pool)) pool <- setdiff(all_genes, pos_set)
    sample(pool, 1)
  }) %>% unique()
}

# ── Permutation test (one method) ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Returns list: null_dens (numeric vector), p_val (scalar), obs (metrics list)
run_permutation <- function(edges, all_genes, degree_tbl, pos_set, nperm,
                             method = c("degree_matched", "degree_length", "rewire", "naive"),
                             length_tbl = NULL, rewire_mult = 10) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  obs    <- compute_metrics(edges, pos_set)
  k      <- length(pos_set)

  if (method == "rewire") {
    g  <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
            edges[, c("node1", "node2")], directed = FALSE,
            vertices = unique(c(edges$node1, edges$node2))
          ) %>% igraph::simplify()
    nd <- numeric(nperm)
    for (i in seq_len(nperm)) {
      g_rw <- igraph::rewire(g, igraph::keeping_degseq(niter = igraph::ecount(g) * rewire_mult))
      e_rw <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_rw, "edges")
      nd[i] <- compute_metrics(tibble(node1 = e_rw$from, node2 = e_rw$to), pos_set)$density
    }
    return(list(null_dens = nd, p_val = mean(nd >= obs$density, na.rm = TRUE), obs = obs))
  }

  nd <- numeric(nperm)
  for (i in seq_len(nperm)) {
    rs <- switch(method,
      degree_matched = .sample_degree_matched(all_genes, degree_tbl, pos_set),
      degree_length  = .sample_degree_length_matched(all_genes, degree_tbl, length_tbl, pos_set),
      naive          = sample(all_genes, k, replace = FALSE)
    )
    if (length(rs) < k)
      rs <- c(rs, sample(setdiff(all_genes, rs), k - length(rs)))
    nd[i] <- compute_metrics(edges, rs)$density
  }
  list(null_dens = nd, p_val = mean(nd >= obs$density, na.rm = TRUE), obs = obs)
}

# ── Jackknife: leave-one-candidate-out ────────────────────────────────────────
jackknife_influence <- function(edges, pos_set, node_info, n_max = 30) {
  if (length(pos_set) <= 1)
    return(tibble(STRING_ID = character(), short_id = character(),
                  description = character(), density_without = numeric(), delta = numeric()))

  base       <- compute_metrics(edges, pos_set)$density
  candidates <- if (length(pos_set) > n_max) sample(pos_set, n_max) else pos_set

  bind_rows(map(candidates, function(g) {
    d <- compute_metrics(edges, setdiff(pos_set, g))$density
    tibble(STRING_ID = g, density_without = d, delta = base - d)
  })) %>%
    left_join(node_info %>% select(STRING_ID, short_id, description), by = "STRING_ID") %>%
    arrange(desc(delta))
}

# ── 4-panel permutation plot (patchwork) ─────────────────────────────────────
plot_permutations <- function(perm_list, obs_density, sp_label) {
  cols <- c(degree_matched = "steelblue3", degree_length = "forestgreen",
             rewired = "purple4",           naive = "grey50")
  lbls <- c(degree_matched = "Degree-matched",   degree_length = "Degree + length",
             rewired = "Network rewiring",         naive = "Naive")

  plots <- imap(perm_list, function(res, method) {
    tibble(x = res$null_dens) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = x)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = cols[[method]], colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = obs_density, colour = "firebrick",
                 linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text", x = obs_density, y = Inf,
               label = sprintf(" obs = %.4f", obs_density),
               hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 3, colour = "firebrick") +
      labs(
        title    = lbls[[method]],
        subtitle = sprintf("p = %.3f", res$p_val),
        x        = "Null subgraph density",
        y        = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40"))
  })

  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = sprintf("%s  |  Candidate subgraph density (obs = %.4f)", sp_label, obs_density),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
    )
}
```

---

# `r params$experiment_name`

**STRING score threshold:** `r params$score_threshold`
| **Permutations:** `r params$n_permutations`
| **Candidate type:** branch-specific MKT (from input `.txt` files)
| **Output:** `r params$output_dir`

---

## Per-species analysis

```{r per-species, results='asis', fig.show='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
set.seed(params$seed)
dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

all_network_summaries <- list()

for (.sp in names(params$species_configs)) {
  .cfg <- params$species_configs[[.sp]]

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", .cfg$label))

  # ── 1. Load inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!file.exists(.cfg$candidate_ids_file))
    stop("Candidate IDs file not found: ", .cfg$candidate_ids_file)
  if (!file.exists(.cfg$network_edge_file))
    stop("Network edge file not found: ", .cfg$network_edge_file)

  .pos_ids  <- load_candidate_ids(.cfg$candidate_ids_file)
  .edges    <- load_interactions(.cfg$network_edge_file, params$score_threshold)
  .node_inf <- load_node_info(.cfg$network_node_file)
  .lengths  <- load_gene_lengths(.cfg$output_dir, .cfg$network_node_file)

  # ── 2. Gene sets ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .all_ids      <- unique(c(.edges$node1, .edges$node2))
  .pos_in_net   <- intersect(.pos_ids, .all_ids)
  .n_pos        <- length(.pos_in_net)
  .n_all        <- length(.all_ids)

  cat(sprintf(
    "- Candidate STRING IDs: **%d** loaded, **%d** present in network\n",
    length(.pos_ids), .n_pos
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "- Network: **%d** nodes, **%d** edges (score ≥ %.1f)\n",
    .n_all, nrow(.edges), params$score_threshold
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "- Gene length data available: **%s** (%d genes mapped)\n\n",
    if (nrow(.lengths) > 0) "yes" else "no (using degree-only matching)",
    nrow(.lengths)
  ))

  if (.n_pos < 2) {
    cat("*Fewer than 2 candidates present in the network — skipping species.*\n")
    next
  }

  # ── 3. Observed metrics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .obs <- compute_metrics(.edges, .pos_in_net)
  cat(sprintf(
    "**Observed:** %d candidate–candidate edges out of %d possible pairs (density = **%.4f**)\n\n",
    .obs$edges_between, .obs$possible_pairs, .obs$density
  ))

  # ── 4. Degree distribution ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .degree_tbl <- bind_rows(
    .edges %>% transmute(gene = node1),
    .edges %>% transmute(gene = node2)
  ) %>%
    count(gene, name = "degree")

  .w_test <- wilcox.test(
    .degree_tbl$degree[.degree_tbl$gene %in% .pos_in_net],
    .degree_tbl$degree[!(.degree_tbl$gene %in% .pos_in_net)]
  )

  .deg_plot <- .degree_tbl %>%
    mutate(category = if_else(gene %in% .pos_in_net, "Candidate", "Neutral")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = degree, fill = category)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.6, adjust = 1.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Candidate = "firebrick3", Neutral = "steelblue3")) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(
      title    = sprintf("%s — Degree distribution (log scale)", .cfg$label),
      subtitle = sprintf("Wilcoxon W = %.0f, p = %.4f", .w_test$statistic, .w_test$p.value),
      x        = "Degree (log10)",
      y        = "Density",
      fill     = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40"))

  print(.deg_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── 5. Permutation tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .perm_dm    <- run_permutation(.edges, .all_ids, .degree_tbl, .pos_in_net,
                                  params$n_permutations, "degree_matched")
  .perm_dl    <- run_permutation(.edges, .all_ids, .degree_tbl, .pos_in_net,
                                  params$n_permutations, "degree_length",
                                  length_tbl = .lengths)
  .perm_rew   <- run_permutation(.edges, .all_ids, .degree_tbl, .pos_in_net,
                                  params$n_permutations, "rewire",
                                  rewire_mult = params$rewire_multiplier)
  .perm_naive <- run_permutation(.edges, .all_ids, .degree_tbl, .pos_in_net,
                                  params$n_permutations, "naive")

  print(
    plot_permutations(
      list(degree_matched = .perm_dm, degree_length = .perm_dl,
           rewired = .perm_rew,       naive = .perm_naive),
      obs_density = .obs$density,
      sp_label    = .cfg$label
    )
  )
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── 6. P-value summary table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .pval_tbl <- tibble(
    Method      = c("Degree-matched", "Degree + length", "Network rewiring", "Naive"),
    Null_type   = c("Permutation", "Permutation", "Degree-sequence preserving rewiring", "Permutation"),
    p_value     = c(.perm_dm$p_val, .perm_dl$p_val, .perm_rew$p_val, .perm_naive$p_val),
    Significant = if_else(c(.perm_dm$p_val, .perm_dl$p_val, .perm_rew$p_val, .perm_naive$p_val) < 0.05,
                           "yes", "no")
  )

  print(
    kable(.pval_tbl, digits = 3,
          caption = sprintf("%s — Permutation test p-values (obs density = %.4f)",
                            .cfg$label, .obs$density)) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
      row_spec(which(.pval_tbl$p_value < 0.05), bold = TRUE)
  )
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── 7. Jackknife influence ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("#### Jackknife influence (top candidates by subgraph density contribution)\n\n")
  .jk <- jackknife_influence(.edges, .pos_in_net, .node_inf)
  if (nrow(.jk) > 0) {
    print(
      kable(head(.jk, 15), digits = 4,
            caption = sprintf("%s — Leave-one-out influence on subgraph density", .cfg$label)) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  # ── 8. Candidate–candidate interaction table ──────────────────────────────────
  cat("#### Candidate–candidate interactions\n\n")
  .cc_pairs <- .edges %>%
    filter(node1 %in% .pos_in_net & node2 %in% .pos_in_net) %>%
    left_join(.node_inf %>% select(STRING_ID, short_id, description),
              by = c("node1" = "STRING_ID")) %>%
    rename(id1 = short_id, desc1 = description) %>%
    left_join(.node_inf %>% select(STRING_ID, short_id, description),
              by = c("node2" = "STRING_ID")) %>%
    rename(id2 = short_id, desc2 = description) %>%
    transmute(
      Protein_1    = if_else(!is.na(id1), id1, node1),
      Protein_2    = if_else(!is.na(id2), id2, node2),
      Score        = score,
      Function_1   = str_trunc(desc1, 60),
      Function_2   = str_trunc(desc2, 60),
      species      = .cfg$label
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Score))

  if (nrow(.cc_pairs) > 0) {
    print(
      kable(head(.cc_pairs %>% select(-species), 20), digits = 3,
            caption = sprintf("%s — Top candidate–candidate interactions (n = %d total)",
                              .cfg$label, nrow(.cc_pairs))) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
    )
  } else {
    cat("*No candidate–candidate interactions detected above the score threshold.*\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── 9. Per-candidate connectivity summary ─────────────────────────────────────
  cat("#### Per-candidate connectivity\n\n")
  .connectivity <- bind_rows(
    .edges %>% transmute(src = node1, tgt = node2),
    .edges %>% transmute(src = node2, tgt = node1)
  ) %>%
    filter(src %in% .pos_in_net) %>%
    mutate(partner_type = if_else(tgt %in% .pos_in_net, "candidate", "neutral")) %>%
    group_by(src) %>%
    summarise(
      total_degree       = n_distinct(tgt),
      candidate_partners = n_distinct(tgt[partner_type == "candidate"]),
      neutral_partners   = n_distinct(tgt[partner_type == "neutral"]),
      .groups            = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(.node_inf %>% select(STRING_ID, short_id, description),
              by = c("src" = "STRING_ID")) %>%
    transmute(
      Protein          = if_else(!is.na(short_id), short_id, src),
      STRING_ID        = src,
      Function         = str_trunc(description, 70),
      Total_degree     = total_degree,
      Candidate_partners = candidate_partners,
      Neutral_partners = neutral_partners
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Candidate_partners), desc(Total_degree))

  print(
    kable(.connectivity, digits = 0,
          caption = sprintf("%s — Candidate connectivity summary", .cfg$label)) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
      column_spec(5, bold = TRUE)
  )
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── 10. Save TSVs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .safe_sp <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", .cfg$label)
  .out_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, .safe_sp)
  dir.create(.out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  .net_summary <- tibble(
    species           = .cfg$label,
    n_candidates      = .n_pos,
    n_network_genes   = .n_all,
    n_edges           = nrow(.edges),
    observed_edges_cc = .obs$edges_between,
    possible_pairs    = .obs$possible_pairs,
    density           = .obs$density,
    p_degree_matched  = .perm_dm$p_val,
    p_degree_length   = .perm_dl$p_val,
    p_rewired         = .perm_rew$p_val,
    p_naive           = .perm_naive$p_val,
    wilcox_p_degree   = .w_test$p.value
  )

  write_tsv(.net_summary,     file.path(.out_dir, "network_summary.tsv"))
  write_tsv(.cc_pairs,        file.path(.out_dir, "candidate_candidate_interactions.tsv"))
  write_tsv(.connectivity,    file.path(.out_dir, "candidate_connectivity.tsv"))
  write_tsv(.jk,              file.path(.out_dir, "jackknife_influence.tsv"))

  all_network_summaries[[.sp]] <- .net_summary
}
```

## Cross-species summary

```{r cross-species, results='asis'}
if (length(all_network_summaries) > 1) {
  .summary_all <- bind_rows(all_network_summaries) %>%
    select(species, n_candidates, n_network_genes, n_edges,
           observed_edges_cc, density,
           p_degree_matched, p_degree_length, p_rewired, p_naive)

  print(
    kable(.summary_all, digits = 3,
          caption = "Cross-species network summary") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
      column_spec(which(names(.summary_all) %in%
                          c("p_degree_matched", "p_degree_length", "p_rewired", "p_naive")),
                  bold = TRUE)
  )

  write_tsv(
    bind_rows(all_network_summaries),
    file.path(params$output_dir, "all_species_network_summary.tsv")
  )
} else {
  cat("*(only one species — cross-species table not generated)*\n")
}
```

cat(sprintf("Experiment     : %s\n", params$experiment_name))
cat(sprintf("Score threshold: %.2f\n", params$score_threshold))
cat(sprintf("Permutations   : %d\n",   params$n_permutations))
